thread:
kai: Morning — first-day onboarding. I kicked off the onboard pipeline and the build fails at the step that exchanges OIDC for creds with error 'token claim aud missing'. Also the docker push later got 403. Anyone know which creds flow onboarding expects?

ci-bot: build #1 queued on hosted-agent-9

marco: welcome! Short answer: our onboarding flow tries OIDC for hosted agents but the org GH App isn't configured with the Buildkite audience by default, which gives you the aud error. For image pushes we usually use a short-lived machine token instead.

kai: ah ok. Is there a quick patch so I can finish the walkthrough?

infra-team: Quick unblock: update the pipeline to skip the OIDC exchange and add a login step using GHCR_ONBOARD_TOKEN (store in vault). Example:
```
- command: |
    echo "$GHCR_ONBOARD_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io -u onboard-bot --password-stdin
  env:
    GHCR_ONBOARD_TOKEN: "%{secure:GHCR_ONBOARD_TOKEN}%"
```
We'll issue a short-lived token if you request via https://redwood.internal/access-requests (choose 'onboard-machine-token').

kai: did that and docker login succeeded but the build then errored pulling cache with 'request canceled while waiting for connection' from S3.

marco: we've had a recent S3 egress blip on the hosted-agent pool. For onboarding, either set cache restore: false or run the step on the elastic-us-west queue. Skipping cache is fine for first-day runs.

kai: skipping cache got me through. Filing the access request now and will update the repo README to note 'use public base image for onboarding' to avoid GHCR push.

docs: Thanks — opened docs PR to add an onboarding troubleshooting section (OIDC vs token, GHCR scopes, cache egress): https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/123

infra-team: Noted. We'll follow up to configure the GH App OIDC audience and investigate the S3 egress incidents. If you hit any more blockers ping infra and include build #.

kai: All good, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
